name: Velex LumiPanel Legging
description: A full-length compression legging in matte black with three vertical panels of optically clear biopolymer film running from hip to ankle on each leg. The panels are designed to sit over bioluminescent skin patches without interfering with light output — the glow shows through clean and unfiltered. On non-bioluminescent wearers, the transparent strips simply reveal skin.
functionality: Transparent panels allow bioluminescent geneware to display through fabric; panels are scratch-resistant and UV-stable
what_it_says: You got the bioluminescence and you're not hiding it under opaque fabric like it embarrasses you.
worn_by: people who treat their mods as aesthetic
story_hooks: The panels on a contact's leggings are dark — their bioluminescence has stopped working, which shouldn't be possible without intervention.
A knockoff version uses cheaper film that yellows the glow, marking the wearer as someone who can't afford the real thing.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, athletic silhouette with a modern minimalist edge. The matte black compression legging is interrupted by three vertical columns of crystal-clear biopolymer film running the length of each leg, creating an almost architectural visual rhythm. On bioluminescent wearers, the effect is striking—glowing skin visible through transparent panels creates vertical light-stripes down the legs. On non-augmented wearers, it simply reveals natural skin tone, creating subtle human-vs-tech contrast.
physical_description.fit: Compression fit, second-skin tight from waist through ankle. High-rise waistband with subtle ergonomic shaping. Hugs musculature without restricting movement.
physical_description.primary_material: High-performance synth-spandex blend base with embedded moisture-wicking nano-fiber. Biopolymer film panels are optically perfect clarity—lab-grade transparency without distortion or cloudiness.
physical_description.texture: Matte finish on the black sections—anti-glare, absorbs light. The biopolymer panels are perfectly smooth and cool to the touch, faintly tactile grip texture on inner thigh.
physical_description.color_scheme: Flat matte black as primary with translucent-to-clear biopolymer accent panels. When worn by bioluminescent users, the color palette shifts to include cyan, violet, or custom biolume hues glowing through the transparent sections.
physical_description.closures: High-waistband elastic with integrated friction-lock seam. No visible fasteners—designed as slip-on.
distinctive_features: Three vertical biopolymer panels per leg (six total) engineered for zero light interference
Anti-reflective matte finish on black sections prevents corpo surveillance detection
Moisture-wicking tech designed for high-performance augmented athletes
Subtle Velex branding on inner waistband in microscopic print
Reinforced seams at hip and ankle joints for durability
The transparent panels sit flush with the fabric—no ridges or bubbling
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury tech wear. This is specialized biomod-compatible apparel for wealthy augmentation enthusiasts. Price point is Φ180-240.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corpo athletes, biomod enthusiasts, and augmented elites who want to display their modifications with pride. Also favored by underground bioluminescent performers in GLMZ nightclubs. Signals disposable income and body modification confidence.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and clean when new. After wear, the black sections may show minor fading on high-friction areas (inner thigh, back of knee). The biopolymer panels resist scratching and maintain clarity indefinitely unless deliberately damaged.
